L2t: Syed Ali Shah Geelani was a long-time Kashmiri separatist politician who had earlier been a member of the Jammu and Kashmir legislative assembly and led the Jamaat-e-Islami in the region.
L3t: Maulvi Umer Farooq's chairmanship of the All Parties Hurriyat Conference ended in the late 1990s, right after the 1996 state elections and just before the end of that decade, when Geelani took over the chair.
L4t: Geelani replaced Maulvi Umer Farooq as chairman of the All Parties Hurriyat Conference in 1998.
L2f: The All Parties Hurriyat Conference was formed in 1993 as an alliance of Kashmiri separatist groups, and its chairmanship has rotated annually among its member parties by a fixed written rule.
L3f: Geelani took over the Hurriyat chair only after the 2002 state assembly elections, when Maulvi Umer Farooq stepped down following the leadership split that came after that vote.
L4f: Geelani replaced Maulvi Umer Farooq as chairman of the All Parties Hurriyat Conference in 2003.
